'''''Coruscant's News Desk''''' was a section of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] transmitting news from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the news was delivered by [[Ultana Anya]], a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] newscaster.
